hypotheses.subject: legacy-checkout-fallback
hypotheses.summary: The feature flag `legacy-checkout-fallback` was toggled from on to off at 22:39, at which point account page requests began failing with ZeroDivisionError instead of the pre-existing low-level UpstreamTimeout noise. Error rate jumped from ~0-2% to 12% during the mixed-evaluation minute and 28-32% once all evaluations were off.

supporting_evidence.claim: INFO io-shop: legacy-checkout-fallback=on - 200 evaluations (every minute from 22:09 through 22:38)
ERROR io-shop: account page request failed - ZeroDivisionError: division by zero (first appearance, replacing UpstreamTimeout errors)
error_rate rose from 0.0 at 22:38 to 0.125 at 22:39 and 0.32 at 22:40, with request_volume flat at 1200
WARN io-shop: account page error rate at 32% over the last minute

hypotheses.summary: Alternatively, a latent code defect on the non-fallback (new checkout) path was exposed rather than caused by the toggle - the division-by-zero exists in the primary code path and would recur whenever the flag is off. No deploy is recorded in the 24h before onset, so the code itself did not change.

supporting_evidence.claim: Every recorded change to io-shop from 2026-09-14T22:39:00Z to 2026-09-15T22:39:00Z. (nothing changed in this window)
ERROR io-shop: account page request failed - ZeroDivisionError: division by zero
